extractedItems.title: Penalty for Playing from the Wrong Spot After a Drop
extractedItems.question: If you drop your ball outside the relief area and play from there, what is the standard penalty?
extractedItems.explanation: Playing from the wrong spot after a drop usually results in a 2 stroke penalty.

extractedItems.title: Penalty for Dropping Incorrectly but Playing from the Right Spot
extractedItems.question: What is the penalty if you drop your ball incorrectly but it comes to rest in the correct relief area and you play it?
extractedItems.explanation: There is a 1 stroke penalty for dropping incorrectly but playing from the correct spot.

extractedItems.title: Penalty for Placing Instead of Dropping
extractedItems.question: What happens if you place your ball instead of dropping it when required by the rules?
extractedItems.explanation: Placing the ball when a drop is required results in 2 penalty strokes.

extractedItems.title: What to Do When Play Is Suspended Due to a Thunderstorm
extractedItems.question: If a warning signal stops play because of a thunderstorm, what should you do with your ball?

choices.text: Leave it where it is and return to the clubhouse
Pick it up and take it with you without marking
Mark its position, lift it, and replace it later
Play your shot quickly before leaving

extractedItems.explanation: You should mark your ball, lift it, and return it to the same spot when play resumes.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage boy golfer marking his golf ball on the fairway as a thunderstorm approaches.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen boy golfer marks a golf ball on the fairway with dark storm clouds above.

extractedItems.title: What To Do If There's a Risk of Lightning
extractedItems.question: If you believe there is a risk of lightning, what are you allowed to do?

choices.text: Keep playing until the Committee officially suspends play
Wait for your friends to decide
Stop playing immediately for your own safety
Only stop playing if it starts to rain

extractedItems.explanation: You don't have to wait for the suspension signal if there's a risk of lightning. Safety comes first.
